Cars + Cocaine Money Glitch

Story Mode; reported exploit, not a cheat code. The reliable core is warehouse cocaine respawning while bags stay in vehicle storage. A two-car payout loop at Dunk's is community-reported ONLY; confirm real credits, not merely a changing counter. Back up your save.

1. Prepare two vehicles
a) Chapter 2 is safer: Chapter 1 story progress can take your cash.
b) Register BOTH vehicles before filling: a 10-slot van AND a 6-slot car. Use owned cars or register each at Pay n Spray or Moses; do not rely on unregistered stolen vehicles.
c) Keep a separate manual backup save; do not enable cheats.

2. Fill with cocaine
a) Drive to Apollo Aggregates, red warehouse east of Hamlet, off Emory Ave. Press Map to emulate the warehouse location.
b) Loot cocaine from the outside teddy-bear van, the inside van, office table and safe; take the center van's cash bag.
c) Fill and stow bags in your 10-slot van, then your second car. Leave the INSIDE warehouse van parked so its loot can reset.

3. Refresh by switching characters
a) Leave your collected cocaine stored in your vehicles. Switch to the other playable character, then switch back.
b) Return to Apollo Aggregates and recheck the inside van and office safe for respawned cocaine. Reload your vehicles; repeat.
c) If it does not reset, put bags in an owned vehicle, save to a separate slot, reload, then return. Do not overwrite your backup.

4. Two-car Dunk's loop (UNVERIFIED)
a) At Dunk's trailer, reverse the FULL 10-slot van to the drop point and unload its bags.
b) Move the van out, back the full 6-slot car into place, and unload.
c) A player claims that repeating character pickup/drop-off after the swap keeps storage from depleting (~$13,200/drop). This may be a VISUAL bug with no payout: test a small sale first.

5. Check payout or sell normally
a) Verify actual bank balance, pending payments and safehouse mail before relying on repeat sales.
b) If the two-car claim fails, sell the filled van normally. Donnie/Dunk in early chapters or Tyrone (Ch3, best narcotics rate); Brian's Lockup uses keypad 7700 and pays later.
c) Exact prices, vehicle slots, respawns and patch status vary.

Randomized safe codes

This list collects published fixed or reported combinations. Not all map safes have a reusable code. Many ordinary store and bank robbery safes change the code between runs or saves. Some mission codes also vary.

Find the clue: check back-office notes, whiteboards, maps, computers or guards. Press L3 + R3 (both sticks) to activate Focus Mode. Use the Safe Code? dialogue prompt during a robbery when available. Check Notes on the keypad if you already collected the clue.

If a code fails, do not assume a game bug; check your local clue. Retain every leading zero. Some keypads accept five or six digits, and some computers accept words.

Sticky bombs can force open some safes but attract enemies or police. Locked mission doors and garage keypads may not respond to explosives.

Entries are based on published guides through 24 Nov 2026 and have not been independently tested by this app's maintainers.
